requirements.title: Reconcile legal envelope and agency concept
requirements.acceptance: Written zoning memo tied to survey, mapped MIH/subdistrict boundaries, special elevated-rail rules and affordable housing qualification.

requirements.title: Use actual community priorities
requirements.acceptance: Published Jerome CVR and traceable proposal response; avoid fabricating survey results.

requirements.title: Confirm legal control and disposition
requirements.acceptance: Current title, restrictions/easements and disposition/development documents.

requirements.title: Verify existing occupants and obligations
requirements.acceptance: Site/lease verification and any relocation or tenant protection requirements.

requirements.title: Determine environmental pathway and costs
requirements.acceptance: Applicable Phase I or alternate BCP/E materials, noise/air assessment and review disposition.

requirements.title: Underwrite co-op development and buyer affordability
requirements.acceptance: Complete sources/uses and sales/maintenance/reserve model; funding availability and rates.

requirements.title: Determine approvals and schedule
requirements.acceptance: Written eligibility and approvals roadmap; separate public-land disposition from zoning change.

requirements.title: Verify developer/program qualifications
requirements.acceptance: Pre-qualified status and applicable HDFC/sponsor experience evidence.

requirements.title: Measure usable transit access
requirements.acceptance: Dated pedestrian route plus scheduled/reliability-aware travel comparisons and accessibility limits.

requirements.title: Test who can actually buy and remain
requirements.acceptance: Income/assets/credit, down payment and closing costs; maintenance escalation, reserves and resale restrictions.

requirements.title: Complete site-specific procurement requirements
requirements.acceptance: Issued Jerome RFP, amendments and final threshold checklist; no borrowing another site’s criteria.

requirements.title: Provide dimensioned professional design
requirements.acceptance: Survey-based plans, areas, core/lift layout, program and amenity mix, accessibility and signed cost estimate.
